mapper.insert: INSERT INTO staff(name, role, phone, hire_on, leave_on, is_active, created_at) VALUES (#{name}, #{role}, #{phone}, #{hireOn}, #{leaveOn}, #{isActive}, #{createdAt})
mapper.update: UPDATE staff SET is_active = #{active} WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM staff ORDER BY is_active DESC, id DESC
SELECT * FROM staff WHERE is_active = 1 ORDER BY id
SELECT staff_id FROM sys_user WHERE id = #{userId} AND staff_id IS NOT NULL
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO commission_rule(scope, ref_id, staff_role, ratio_bp, fixed_cent, effective_from, effective_to, is_active, remark, created_at) VALUES (#{scope}, #{refId}, #{staffRole}, #{ratioBp}, #{fixedCent}, #{effectiveFrom}, #{effectiveTo}, #{isActive}, #{remark}, #{createdAt})
mapper.update: UPDATE commission_rule SET is_active = #{active} WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT r.*, CASE r.scope WHEN 'SERVICE' THEN (SELECT name FROM service_item WHERE id = r.ref_id) WHEN 'PRODUCT' THEN (SELECT name FROM product WHERE id = r.ref_id) ELSE NULL END AS ref_name FROM commission_rule r ORDER BY r.is_active DESC, r.scope, r.id DESC
SELECT * FROM commission_rule WHERE is_active = 1 AND effective_from <= #{date} AND (effective_to IS NULL OR effective_to >= #{date}) ORDER BY effective_from DESC, id DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO commission_record(staff_id, bill_id, bill_item_id, biz_type, base_cent, ratio_bp, fixed_cent, amount_cent, business_date, settle_id, reverse_of_id, remark, created_at) VALUES (#{staffId}, #{billId}, #{billItemId}, #{bizType}, #{baseCent}, #{ratioBp}, #{fixedCent}, #{amountCent}, #{businessDate}, #{settleId}, #{reverseOfId}, #{remark}, #{createdAt})
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM commission_record WHERE bill_id = #{billId} AND amount_cent > 0 AND reverse_of_id IS NULL ORDER BY id

SELECT staff_id AS staffId, COUNT(*) AS cnt, IFNULL(SUM(amount_cent), 0) AS total FROM commission_record WHERE settle_id IS NULL AND business_date >= #{from} AND business_date <= #{to} GROUP BY staff_id ORDER BY staff_id
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO commission_settle(settle_no, month, staff_id, total_cent, record_count, status, operator, remark, created_at) VALUES (#{settleNo}, #{month}, #{staffId}, #{totalCent}, #{recordCount}, #{status}, #{operator}, #{remark}, #{createdAt})
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM commission_settle WHERE staff_id = #{staffId} AND month = #{month}

SELECT st.id AS staffId, st.name AS staffName, st.role AS staffRole, IFNULL(SUM(CASE WHEN b.id IS NOT NULL AND i.paid_by_card = 0 THEN i.amount_cent ELSE 0 END), 0) AS itemAmount, (SELECT IFNULL(SUM(c.amount_cent), 0) FROM commission_record c WHERE c.staff_id = st.id AND c.business_date >= #{from} AND c.business_date <= #{to}) AS commission FROM staff st LEFT JOIN bill_item i ON i.staff_id = st.id LEFT JOIN bill b ON b.id = i.bill_id AND b.status = 'SETTLED' AND b.business_date >= #{from} AND b.business_date <= #{to} WHERE st.is_active = 1 GROUP BY st.id ORDER BY itemAmount DESC
